subject.title: feat(channels): add typed cross-surface approval actions

question: Should typed approval, URL, and web-app actions plus the new approval-reference SDK subpath become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: This PR expands shipped plugin-facing unions and subpaths while retaining deprecated compatibility inputs, so automation cannot choose the permanent external API and deprecation direction.

options.title: Approve the typed contract
options.body: Keep the new typed actions and narrow SDK subpath, document the compatibility window, and fix the Telegram lane blocker before merge.

options.title: Keep approval internal
options.body: Limit the approval action and locator helper to internal bundled-plugin seams until maintainers design a smaller public API.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold the dependent approval PRs until the presentation and resolver contract is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Approve the typed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new typed actions and narrow SDK subpath, document the compatibility window, and fix the Telegram lane blocker before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the existing typed action surface and merged the durable approval registry foundation, making him the strongest history-backed owner for this API decision.
